name: soundedit
description: Edit the sound open in SoundEdit, an audio editor and sample manager for Mac, while you watch and listen; with SoundEdit Pro, a whole folder of samples.

url.title: SoundEdit address
url.description: The address in SoundEdit ▸ Settings ▸ Agent. Leave it unless you changed the port there.

token.title: SoundEdit token
token.description: The token from SoundEdit ▸ Settings ▸ Agent. A new token there turns this one away.
